title: Approximate tangent planes agree where the symmetric difference has density zero
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, A, B ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, x ∈ ℝ^P and r₀ > 0 with Hⁿ(A ∩ closedBall(x, r₀)) < ∞ and Hⁿ(B ∩ closedBall(x, r₀)) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). If Hⁿ((A∖B) ∩ closedBall(x, ρ))/ρⁿ → 0 and Hⁿ((B∖A) ∩ closedBall(x, ρ))/ρⁿ → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (quotients in [0, ∞], ρⁿ = ENNReal.ofReal(ρ)ⁿ), then for every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P: A has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) if and only if B does.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → 0 < r₀ → μHE[n] (A ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → μHE[n] (B ∩ closedBall x r₀) ≠ ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] ((A \ B) ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μHE[n] ((B \ A) ∩ closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q
